en.headline: Observatory cancels amber rainstorm warning at 9:10am
en.dek: The signal, in force since 4am, was lifted after heavy rain over Sai Kung and Lantau; no warning is now in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the amber rainstorm warning at 9:10am on Saturday. The signal had been in force since 4am. RTHK reported that around 5am the Observatory considered raising a red rainstorm warning, then kept the amber signal.

Rain was heaviest over Sai Kung and Lantau. Earlier Observatory figures put rainfall in those districts above 70 millimetres, with many other parts of the city above 30 millimetres. The Observatory had linked the downpours to intense thundery showers associated with upper-air disturbances, and had warned of possible serious flooding.

A thunderstorm warning that had been extended until 10:30am is no longer in force. The Observatory's warnings page showed no warning in force by late morning. Its 11:02am local weather report said that although the rainstorm warning had been cancelled, people should stay alert to the danger of river flooding.
At 11am the Observatory recorded 27 degrees Celsius and relative humidity of 84 per cent. The government has asked the public to report street flooding to the Drainage Services Department.

zh.headline: 天文台上午9時10分取消黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 警告自凌晨4時生效，西貢及大嶼山雨勢較大；上午稍後本港已再無天氣警告生效。
body: 香港天文台周六上午9時10分取消黃色暴雨警告。該警告自凌晨4時生效。香港電台報道，天文台約在上午5時曾考慮改發紅色暴雨警告，其後維持黃色信號。
雨勢以西貢及大嶼山較大。天文台較早時的數字顯示，該兩區雨量超過70毫米，本港多處亦錄得超過30毫米。天文台指與高空擾動相關的驟雨及雷暴影響本港，並曾警告可能出現嚴重水浸。
原先延長至上午10時30分的雷暴警告現已不再生效。天文台警告頁面在上午稍後顯示沒有生效警告。11時02分的本地天氣報告指，暴雨警告雖已取消，市民仍須留意河道泛濫的危險。
上午11時，天文台錄得氣溫27度，相對濕度84%。政府呼籲市民如發現街道水浸，可向渠務署報告。
